blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — AirAsia Philippines ended its Bohol operations on Wednesday with its last scheduled flight arriving at the Bohol-Panglao International Airport (BPIA). The Airbus A320 aircraft operating Flight Z2354 landed at BPIA at about 9:45 a.m., marking the airline’s final scheduled service on the Manila-Bohol route. The company said it suspended its Bohol route as part of broader network and schedule adjustments, while it reviews its domestic operations and focuses on capacity on other routes.
